messages.content: This is a synthetic compatibility test. Inspect the source catalog next: action discover_catalog, catalog kind sources. There are no requirements yet. Do not execute tools.

system:
Choose one host action from the task, using the required native envelope.
This endpoint offers no tools. Return the native JSON decision envelope, not XML or tool-call markup. All four envelope fields are required. action is the host action name; requirement_ids is an array (use [] when no references are needed); reason is the short task explanation or null. payload_json is a JSON-encoded string containing ONLY the selected action payload value, not a whole decision and not an object wrapping the payload field. For actions without payload, payload_json must be null. The host decodes that string into the selected action field and validates the complete decision against the original schema below. Do not include unrelated fields. The outer native schema guarantees only the envelope; all inner constraints still apply. Action-to-payload-field mapping:
